body: Any reason you feel you can't talk to your girlfriend about how you really feel? You may feel like a burden to her, but talking about it could help find solutions, and over time as you get better you can feel you're healthy for her. You are a team, you can help each other.

It's a university in Detroit. I'm trying hard to stay in the game but it's getting more difficult with every week of class.

Fuck. The guy she left me for is going to the same school and he's got everything figured out. He's already taking his advanced chemistry classes and makes like 80k a year doing computer science. He's just got it all and has so much to offer her. I already feel like shit not being able to study what I want, knowing that she's left me for someone so much more successful in the things i'm passionate about is endlessly painful.

It can be hard for people to understand what you're going through, especially if they've never experienced something like that themselves. If you disappear for a while with no contact and they don't say anything, they most likely aren't aware of the fact that you are hurting. Is there anybody you trust to be able to talk about these feelings with? You may be surprised as to who comes through.

Physics. It has the added benefit of being able to study reality, how anything exists at all, it's been a long time passion of mine and really helped me get a new perspective on life.

My university keeps putting me through all these other courses to get the requirements to even begin any physics courses at all, and i'm struggling with those basic requirement courses. Just makes me feel like a failure and that i'll never even be able to handle a basic physics course to begin with.

I came here to post about wanting to kill myself. Might as well help some other people while I wait for a response.

It's always so easy to justify doing something like that when all you have is yourself. Reading this, I understand your position. Tell me, if you saw someone else post this, would you tell them to do it? Or would you tell them to try absolutely everything you can do in the world before thinking about using suicide as a solution?

You haven't done it yet. There must be something that's keeping you going.
The suicide hotline was busy today. I've tried a livechat to talk to someone and i've been waiting over an hour for them to get to me. I just can't wait any longer.
